TR5_usedHint_clamp.claim: hint() reveals the solution's from-square (Tactics:288) and is NOT recorded; the hinted solve grades as a clean win, inflating Glicko + FSRS
evidence: src/ui/Tactics.svelte:288-296 hint() calls trainer.expectedMove() and sets feedback t('tactics.hint',{sq:m.slice(0,2)}) — reveals the FROM-square of the next expected user move

CORRECTION: hint() calls trainer.expectedMove() (TacticalTrainer.ts:38), NOT 'revealSolution'. There is no revealSolution symbol anywhere (grep: only expectedMove). F4's Calculate.revealSolution is a different surface (Calculate, not Tactics).

src/store/db.ts:36-49 PuzzleAttemptRecord has NO usedHint field (fields: id,puzzleId,solved,ms,themes,ratingBefore,ratingAfter,playedAt,source,confidence?,selfTag?). grep usedHint over src = ZERO hits.

src/ui/Tactics.svelte:222-271 finish(solved): calls gradeAttempt(model.puzzleRating,puzzle,solved) (line 227) -> applies full Glicko gain; srs grade = resultToGrade(solved,ms) (line 267) -> Good/Easy on a clean fast solve. A hinted FIRST-attempt solve therefore grades identically to an unaided one (inflation confirmed).

Hinted-then-solve flow: hint() (sets feedback only) -> user plays the revealed move via onMove -> result 'solved' -> finish(true) grades CLEAN. retry() (line 300) is already-graded practice (no re-score), so inflation is on the first post-hint solve, not retry.
